description: Every substage will have its own unlock item. Additionally, you will need to find Unlock
Stage 6-6 and Unlock Stage 6-8 to be able to fight Lexer and King Hades respectively.
Choose a stage as a starting area. A corresponding stage unlock item will be placed in your starting inventory.
A random substage of the chosen stage will be picked as the starting area when Stagesanity is enabled.
Boss stages are excluded from the starting substage pool.
Sets whether or not the Earth Dragon is required for the Big Key location in Stage 3-3
If disabled the player may be required to flap towards the platform with the teleporter.
Sets whether or not the Fire Dragon is required for the Star Medals hidden below clouds in Stages 4-2 and 4-4.
If enabled the Star Medals will require the player to be able to get out of their holes to collect, be it
by thawing the jump pad using the Fire Dragon transformation, or by using the Flashback card with Seline.
If disabled, then the player may collect the Star Medals and temporarily use the Fire Dragon to get out.
Criteria under which Stage 6-6 becomes accessible to fight Lexer.
Star Medals: Collect the required number of Star Medals
Bosses: Defeat the required number of bosses
Spirits: Release the required number of spirits
Number of required Star Medals to collect when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Star Medals.
Number of required bosses to defeat when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Bosses.
Number of required spirits to be released when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Spirits.
